verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe embedding real coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline and others) as native chat backends. They also describe supervising them with a full history of file reads, edits and Allow/Deny approval cards, running parallel agents on git worktrees from one tab, and having agents run test suites in real workspaces. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of repo cloning, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
